# Diabetic Sock Club

> > The #1 rated provider of non-binding, seamless diabetic socks for men and women, featuring USA-made products with a 1-year replacement guarantee and complementary foot care solutions.

Diabetic Sock Club (DSC) specializes in therapeutic diabetic socks made from cotton blends with Lycra and acrylic, designed to prevent circulation issues and neuropathy-related discomfort. The company offers comprehensive diabetic foot care with products including compression socks, hemp neuropathy cream, and foot massagers, all backed by customer satisfaction guarantees.

## Key Topics

- Non-binding seamless socks
- Diabetic neuropathy relief
- Compression socks (graduated pressure)
- Cotton-blend materials
- Made in USA
- Men's and women's styles
- Crew, ankle, and upper-calf lengths
- 6-pair packs
- 1-year replacement guarantee
- Therapeutic foot care
- Hemp cream for nerve pain
- Foot massager with EMS technology
- Moisture-wicking cotton
- Wholesale bulk ordering
- 7,800+ customer reviews
